composition: official Rive underlay -> retained WebGL2 -> official Rive overlay

owns: projected sphere and box guides from the RIVX3D occluder section

runtimeTruth: The official Rive runtime draws only the .riv layers. It does not decode or render the RIVX3D payload.

gpuCanvas.reason: This bundle proves the custom-backend plus official-Rive-frontend architecture. It must not be described as an official GPU Canvas export.

network.hybridEntry: loads the pinned official runtime, the local scene-guides module and its ordinary Rive shape pool

synchronization: Scene guides follow the retained view-projection matrix. The foreground HUD follows the retained TOF phase.
notRenderToTexture: The lower .riv is composited behind WebGL; WebGL does not sample its pixels. Literal Rive-to-shader feedback remains a native GPU Canvas/ORE experiment.
knownLimits: browser occluders are retained but not evaluated
Portfolio companion loads scene-guides.js and a local Rive pool; the older generic underlay.riv is retained as a historical artifact and no longer drawn.
